item.title: School Board Spares Reading Interventionist Positions, Passes Amended Staff Reduction Resolution
item.description: Santa Monica Malibu school board voted to eliminate Language and Literacy Interventionist positions despite community opposition, affecting reading support for struggling students.

item.title: LA28 ticket registrations top 5 million with March deadline approaching
item.description: Over 5 million people from 194 countries registered for 2028 Los Angeles Olympics tickets. Registration closes March 18 for first ticket draw.

item.description: Former Los Angeles fire chief sues city, claiming her firing after the deadly Palisades Fire was politically motivated and unfair.
